Work Task Calendar

How to Use Work Task Calendar

Use the calendar to review work tasks and their required parts by week or by day.

Update the data

  1. Export the latest work-task or material-requisition report as a CSV.
  2. Keep the original header row. Extra source columns may remain.
  3. Select Load CSV, choose the file, and wait for the success message.
  4. Select Export to save an updated standalone HTML copy.

Navigate and filter

Use Today, the date selector, or the arrows to move through dates. Filter by department, task status, issue status, or cost center. Search by WO, task, object, part number, or description.

Department buttons appear only for departments that own a cost center and have tasks in the data. Set which codes belong to which department under Department cost centers below.

Cards and Lines

Cards view groups tasks across the week. Select a task or part to open details. Lines view shows one selected day, while Today shows the full current week; select a card header to reveal all part rows.

Note: Loading a CSV replaces the displayed data for the current browser session. Export a new HTML file to preserve the update.
